## Observation (read-only, 2026-11-18 PST)
The operator's model (decision on `placid-dreary-zethuswasp`, 2026-11-18): each environment has its own signing key; checkouts in the same environment may share one. The live store does not match that model for one key.

- The authorship key with SHA-256 fingerprint prefix `oGCqzgfDMp` (public-key comment `rebar-bot joeoakhart+bot@navapbc.com rotated-20260907`) signs events under 2 environment ids:
  - `ad49f17f-…`: the review bot's tickets clone (`/var/gerrit/site/reviewbot-tickets/.env-id`, per the read-only evidence in `placid-dreary-zethuswasp`'s description). 980 live events signed with it, author "Rebar Bot", 2026-09-07 18:05 to 2026-11-18 21:05 PST.
  - `492a5c71-…`: the operator's Mac checkout (`/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.tickets-tracker/.env-id`). 509 live events, author "Rebar Bot Nava", 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-16 PST (1,338 including compacted events, from 2026-11-02 13:20).
- The Mac's configured `identity.signing_key` is `~/.config/rebar/rebar-bot-signing-key`, file time 2026-11-02 13:18 PST. Its public half has fingerprint prefix `oGCqzgfDMp`, the same key.
- Before 2026-09-07, every environment (Mac clones, review bot, MCP server's predecessor, bridge, reconciler) signed with the earlier key `PU4nHIqJCR`. The MCP server (`eea68b7f`) moved to its own keys (`YWib9Gj1qZ` until 2026-09-07, `biqEFL9T96` from 2026-09-15).

So the same private key lives in at least 2 environments: the server's review-bot clone and the Mac.

## Consequence
Under the key-based `ENV_ID_MISMATCH` rule, env ids signed by one key are treated as checkouts of one environment. A `.env-id` carried between the review bot and the Mac would not be reported. Signatures from that key cannot tell the two writers apart.

## Fix (operator action, 2026-11-19 PST)
The operator chose option (1): the Mac (env 492a5c71) moved to its own key, SHA256:va7mtsoMZ4fqriZ7lEH1dhnzwNJ+q9zbOBuWSKiuvUs, added to identity 594c-9dcf-5ad6-4e6d by the KEY_ADD in tracker commit 9c70c2a2854. The review bot's clone keeps `oGCqzgfDMp`. No repository file changes. The bad-signature results on MCP-server (env eea68b7f) writes are the separate bug starving-sphalerite-skua.

## Verification
- Checked: `ssh-keygen -lf` on the public key in the KEY_ADD event of tracker commit 9c70c2a2854 prints `SHA256:va7mtsoMZ4fqriZ7lEH1dhnzwNJ+q9zbOBuWSKiuvUs`, which differs from the review bot's `oGCqzgfDMp`.
- Checked: `rebar verify-identity --require-authenticated --base 9c70c2a2854~1` on the tracker verifies the KEY_ADD and comment fa102c6da62, which is signed with the new Mac key.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] [non-codebase] The review bot's clone and the Mac sign with different authorship keys: operator records each environment's public-key fingerprint and the date of the change in a ticket comment.
  provenance: environment=rebar tickets store, operator Mac and review-bot clone; principal=operator; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — evidence is the 2026-11-19 PST evidence comment on this ticket: Mac key SHA256:va7mtsoMZ4fqriZ7lEH1dhnzwNJ+q9zbOBuWSKiuvUs via KEY_ADD tracker commit 9c70c2a2854, review bot keeps oGCqzgfDMp, and an enforced `rebar verify-identity --require-authenticated --base 9c70c2a2854~1` verified the KEY_ADD and comment fa102c6da62 signed with the new key.
